name: HCA Healthcare
description: HCA is the largest for-profit US hospital operator. At 2025-12-31 it ran 190 hospitals (179 general acute care, 7 behavioral, 4 rehabilitation), 121 freestanding ambulatory surgery centers and 31 freestanding endoscopy centers in 19 states and England. It is paid per patient visit by Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurers (managed care contracts of one to three years) and self-pay patients, so revenue is admissions and procedures times the price insurers agree to. FY2025 revenue was $75.6 billion (up 7.1 percent, with equivalent admissions up 2.9 percent and revenue per equivalent admission up 4.0 percent) and net income to HCA was $6.784 billion. It is geographically concentrated: Florida and Texas facilities generated 51 percent of consolidated revenue.
